resources.string: Keep a complete, encrypted copy of Nyanime on your own storage. Local backups and Telegram remain available.
Save this key in a safe place. To restore on another phone, enter the same key. It cannot be recovered if you lose it. Paste an existing key here to access your previous backups.
I have saved the key securely
Google handles account selection and consent. Nyanime requests its private application data folder and your email address to identify the selected account. Your other Drive files are not accessible.
Drive is prepared but has not been registered for this Nyanime build yet. This is a developer setup, not a step every user will need to repeat once the app is registered.

1. Create or select a Google Cloud project and enable Google Drive API.

2. Configure Google Auth Platform: app name, support contact, audience and test users while testing.

3. Create an Android OAuth client using the package and SHA-1 shown below. For Play builds, use the Play app-signing certificate.

4. Add drive.appdata and userinfo.email. No client secret or upstream credentials are needed. Allow time for Google to apply the changes, then return here.
I registered this package and signing certificate in my own Google Cloud project

Backups contain settings and credentials and are encrypted before upload. Media downloads are excluded. The server can see file size, backup time and device name. Keep your recovery key outside this phone.
Connected. No verified backup has been created on this phone yet.
No verified backups found for this recovery key.
Copies to keep for this phone
Android schedules background work when the network and device allow it. Old copies are removed only after a new backup has been verified. Copies from other phones are kept.
Connection requires your attention. Reconnect to grant access; for Drive, check the OAuth package, certificate, test users and Drive API configuration.
Configuration is missing or unavailable. Reconnect this storage location.
Not enough storage on this phone or the remote server. Free some space and try again.
This recovery key is not valid. Paste the complete NYK1 key.

Enter the HTTPS address of an existing WebDAV folder. Keep the username and password in their separate fields; the address must not contain query parameters.
